svg.title: What I’m exploring now
svg.desc: A data pipe arrives from above and feeds water.exe, a small window with a pixel-art watering can. The can pours water into the Canopy window onto a seed, and a binary tangerine tree grows in five stages that match changelog.md: Day 0 seed, Day 13 sprout, Day 30 sapling, Day 60 canopy, Day 90 the grown tree with its first ripe tangerine. Kirby hops on the changelog window, and Don Quixote bobs on the Canopy window.
